messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part5 Output: Different values for number of valid days

Thanks John for reporting this, it seems to be a real bug. The Nvaliddays columns is problem not correct.
You can find progress on this issue here on GitHub. I think I fixed the problem and I have asked Jairo to double check my solution before we merge it into the main version of GGIR.
Best, Vincent
